name: Glitter Invitation
summary:
Glitter Invitation from Snow Drop is an Indie 3D adventure simulation where you have to travel into a book world populated by giantesses.
Its a sequel/spin off of the giantess beat 'em up Indie game "Grimm Glitter" taking place not too long after the events of that game. Guided by a mysterious invitation, you play an unnamed male protagonist and meet once again the female protagonists (Aoi, Alice & Gulliver) in their book world as well as the two previous antagonists (Kaori & Mitama) of "Grimm Glitter".

This is a game where the decisions you make in some events will decide if you become friends with the giantesses, end up squashed by them..or do spicy things with them.
